iti61:1.1: (Tik. II.) Vuttaṃ hetaṃ bhagavatā vuttam-arahatā ti me sutaṃ.
iti61:2.1: {Tīṇ'imāni} bhikkhave cakkhūni. Katamāni tīṇi? Maṃsacakkhu dibbacakkhu paññācakkhu, imāni kho bhikkhave tīṇi cakkhūnīti. Etam-atthaṃ bhagavā avoca, tatthetaṃ iti vuccati:
iti61:3.1: Maṃsacakkhu dibbacakkhu paññācakkhu anuttaraṃ | etāni tīṇi cakkhūni akkhāsi purisuttamo ||
iti61:4.1: Maṃsacakkhussa uppādo maggo dibbassa cakkhuno | yato ñāṇaṃ udapādi paññācakkhu anuttaraṃ | yassa cakkhussa paṭilābhā sabbadukkhā pamuccatīti ||
iti61:5.1: Ayam-pi attho vutto bhagavatā iti me sutan-ti ||2|| (Tik.
